sampling: deterministic hash-seeded greedy stratified cover (title_qa_select.py); six independent blind-first reviewers x 25 titles
programmatic_rule_fixes: curly apostrophes/quotes normalised before regex matching (117 titles had defeated n't/’ patterns)
Question_Form = literal ? or interrogative opener (How to / Why X / Do this no longer questions)
genuine ?-questions keep archetype QUESTION; Why-led titles do not fire WARNING/MISTAKE/STOP_DOING/AVOID/DO_THIS or Warning/Mistake/Urgency frames
DOCTOR_WARNS needs a warning verb; any *ologist/surgeon counts as a doctor
HEALTH vocabulary extended (nails, feet, stool, covid, vaccines, clove, ...); Health_Topic=1 for every SENIOR_HEALTH-channel title
claim types: bare "health" no longer matches REVERSAL; "Instant Oatmeal" no longer INSTANT_CURE; EXAGGERATED_BENEFIT added
Urgency_Frame no longer fires on bare "before" or calendar years; Fear_Frame adds irreversible/poison/strain/harm/damage
List_Form counts "These 4 Habits"/"All 32 States"; units (kg, lbs, cups) no longer make a list
overpromise proxy fires on by-morning/flush/melt/N kg/Nx/in N hours
analyst_mechanical_fix: unnecessary_words: negation words (never/not/no/stop/...) and items absent from the title removed project-wide; each removal logged
known_limitations: Title_Archetype primary is first-match in a fixed priority list; Title_Archetypes_All is the authoritative multi-label field and should be used for pattern mining
Hope/Positive/Secret/Transformation/Authority_Frame regexes are coarse keyword frames (reviewers disagreed on ~3-7 of 150 rows each)
named-person authority (e.g. "Warren Buffett") is not detected as Authority_Cue
